name: Text to Speech – Reinvent WP
author: Reinvent WP

sections.description:
Reinvent WP Text to Speech (formerly Natural Text To Speech) adds a “Listen” button that reads your posts aloud in a natural AI voice. As the audio plays, the current sentence and word are highlighted on the page, so readers can listen and follow along at the same time. It turns any post into text to audio in seconds, with no setup.

Works right after activation. No API key, no credit card, no configuration. Activate the plugin and the player appears on your posts, powered by 20,000 free characters a month from Reinvent WP Cloud Free.

Use the voice provider you prefer. Start with free voices, connect your own ElevenLabs account (10,000 free characters a month), or upgrade to PRO to use OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google Cloud, Amazon Polly or Azure AI Speech with your own API key. Don’t want to manage API keys? PRO also includes Reinvent WP Cloud PRO: premium voices with no API key and 40,000 characters a month. You can switch providers at any time without changing plugins.

Word highlighting with real AI voices. Every word lights up in sync with the voice, whichever provider you use. Not just robotic browser voices.

Built for news sites, blogs, online courses, accessibility-focused websites, WooCommerce stores and agencies managing many client sites.

Why site owners choose it

  • Word highlighting on real AI audio – Every word lights up in sync with natural AI voices from OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google Cloud, Amazon Polly, Azure or Reinvent WP Cloud, not just robotic browser voices. Visitors can follow the text while they listen, which helps with focus, reading difficulties and long articles.
  • Natural AI voices – ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google Cloud, Amazon Polly and Azure, plus free voices from Reinvent WP Cloud Free.
  • Pay your provider directly – With your own API key, you pay the voice provider for what you use, with no markup from us.
  • 11 player styles – Modern, Classic Controls, Floating Pill, Waveform Card, Glassmorphism, Chapter Timeline, Accessible Controls, Article Contents and more. Colors adapt to your theme.
  • Accessible player – Keyboard controls, ARIA labels, visible focus states and screen-reader-friendly status updates.
  • Lightweight – About 300KB, deferred, and loaded only on pages that use the player.
  • Instant Play – Long posts start playing right away, with no wait for the whole article to be generated.

Free text to speech features

  • Text to speech player with sentence and word highlighting
  • 20,000 free characters a month from Reinvent WP Cloud Free, or your own ElevenLabs free tier
  • Automatic “Listen” button on posts, a Gutenberg block (search for “Reinvent WP TTS”) and the [natural_tts] shortcode
  • Customizable player: styles, colors, button labels and position
  • Accessible player controls
  • Listening analytics: plays, listening time and completion rate

PRO text to speech features

  • Bring your own key for OpenAI TTS, ElevenLabs, Google Cloud TTS, Amazon Polly and Azure AI Speech
  • Reinvent WP Cloud PRO – premium voices with no API key, 40,000 characters a month for monthly and annual subscribers
  • Smart audio caching – generate audio once and reuse it to keep API costs down
  • MP3 export and bulk MP3 generation
  • Post to Podcast – turn posts into podcast episodes with an RSS feed for Spotify, Apple Podcasts and other platforms
  • Pronunciation rules for technical terms, abbreviations and names
  • ElevenLabs audio tags with Eleven v3 and v4 (for example [whispers] or [laughs])
  • Usage limits – 5-hour, daily and monthly character quotas and rate limiting
  • Advanced shortcode options

See PRO plans

Supported text to speech languages

The plugin works with 140+ languages and variants and 1,000+ voices across providers. The available languages and voices depend on the text to speech provider you choose:

  • OpenAI TTS: 57 languages, 11 voices
  • ElevenLabs: 29+ languages, 1,000+ voices
  • Google Cloud TTS: 40+ languages and variants, 200+ voices
  • Amazon Polly: 41 languages and variants, 100+ voices
  • Azure AI Speech: 140+ languages and variants, 400+ voices

Tested and confirmed working in Afrikaans, Arabic, Armenian, Azerbaijani, Belarusian, Bengali, Bosnian, Bulgarian, Catalan, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Finnish, French, Galician, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Kazakh, Korean, Latvian, Lithuanian, Macedonian, Malay, Maori, Marathi, Nepali, Norwegian, Persian (Farsi), Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Tagalog, Tamil, Telugu, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, Vietnamese and Welsh. Kannada and Thai are not supported yet.

Hear live demos in every language →

Compatibility

Works with most themes, page builders and plugins, including:

  • Builders and themes: Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, Avada, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, Brizy, SiteOrigin
  • Multilingual: WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress, GTranslate
  • Caching: LiteSpeed Cache, WP-Optimize, W3 Total Cache, Autoptimize, Speed Optimizer
  • Custom post types: WooCommerce products, ACF, Custom Post Type UI, Toolset Types

Use it outside WordPress

Need the same player on a custom site or a React / Next.js app? Use the JavaScript embed or the NPM package.

Support

Ask questions in the support forum. We aim to reply within 24 hours. You can also use the live chat on reinventwp.com, email reinventwp@gmail.com, or join us on Telegram or Discord.

Found a bug or have an idea? Report a bug or request a feature.

Pricing

The free version is free forever. PRO plans:

  • Monthly: 1 site $6 · 5 sites $20 · 20 sites $120
  • Annual: 1 site $69 · 5 sites $79 · 20 sites $249
  • Lifetime: 1 site $200 · 5 sites $700 · 20 sites $1,000

Reinvent WP Cloud PRO characters (40,000 a month) are included with monthly and annual plans. Lifetime plans don’t include Cloud PRO characters; use your own API key instead. Compare plans

Shortcodes

The player is added to your posts automatically. Use the Gutenberg block (search for “Reinvent WP TTS”) or the shortcode to place and configure it yourself:

[natural_tts target-tts-direction="below"]
[natural_tts target-tts-selector="body"]
[natural_tts lang="ru-RU"]
[natural_tts src="https://example.com/audio.mp3"]
[natural_tts trigger-play="all"]

[natural_tts]
  {
    "read_title": true
  }
[/natural_tts]

External Services

Nothing is sent until you use the related feature. Audio files and settings stay on your site.

Reinvent WP Cloud (services.reinventwp.com, operated by us)

  • Voice (the default provider): when a visitor presses play, their browser sends the text to be read, so the service also sees their IP address. Your site URL and plan are sent to check your quota.
  • License: opening the settings page checks your license through Freemius (email, site URL, license and plan).
  • Error logs: the error message, plugin version and site URL.
  • Apps list: the Reinvent WP → Dashboard page downloads the list of apps at most once a day. Nothing about you is sent.
  • Assistant: when you send a question, it sends the question, any files you attach (emails, IP addresses, passwords and keys are hidden first), the last few messages and your Reinvent WP plugins with their versions. Nothing is stored. Feedback you send from it goes to our team with your email and site address.

reinventwp.com: shows offers on the settings page and records whether they were shown, dismissed or clicked.

Your own voice provider (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google Cloud, Amazon Polly, Azure AI Speech, or a Custom API address you enter): the text is sent from your site straight to that provider with your API key. Keys stay in your WordPress database and are never sent to us. See each provider’s privacy policy: OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft Azure.

ElevenLabs links are affiliate links: we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.

Terms of Service | Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New (search for “Reinvent WP Text to Speech” or “text to speech”), or upload the .zip file.
  2. Activate it.
  3. A “Listen” button appears on your posts. Open any post and press play.
  4. You get 20,000 free characters a month from Reinvent WP Cloud Free right away. No API key or credit card needed.

To change the voice, player style or where the player appears, open Reinvent WP Text to Speech in your WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Is this text to speech plugin free?

Yes. After activation you get 20,000 free characters a month from Reinvent WP Cloud Free, with no setup or credit card. You can also connect your own ElevenLabs account. Upgrade to PRO to use OpenAI, Google Cloud, Amazon Polly or Azure, or for 40,000 characters a month with Reinvent WP Cloud PRO.

Does the text to speech player work with my theme and page builder?

It works with most themes and with Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, Avada, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, Brizy and SiteOrigin. The player is added automatically, so no template editing is needed. If it doesn’t show up on your site, please open a support topic and we’ll help.

Which languages and voices are available?

It depends on the provider you choose. See Supported languages above for the list and links to each provider’s language support.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. It supports custom post types, including WooCommerce products, as well as posts and pages.

Does it help with accessibility (WCAG / ADA)?

It gives visitors an audio alternative to your written content, with keyboard-accessible controls, ARIA labels, visible focus states, screen-reader-friendly status updates and customizable highlight colors. These help you work toward WCAG 2.1 AA. Full compliance also depends on the rest of your site.

How does word highlighting help readers?

As the voice reads the post aloud, the current sentence and word are highlighted. Visitors can follow the text without losing their place, which helps with long articles, small screens, reading difficulties and focus.

Where are my API keys stored?

In your own WordPress database. With your own key, requests go directly from your site to the provider. If you use Reinvent WP Cloud, the text being spoken is processed by our service. See External Services above.

Is it GDPR compliant?

The plugin can be used in a GDPR-compliant way, but compliance depends on which providers you enable and how you describe those data flows in your privacy policy.

Does word highlighting work with OpenAI and other providers that don’t return word timings?

Yes. The plugin works out word timings in the visitor’s browser by matching the text with the generated audio. Highlighting stays in sync with OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Google Cloud, Amazon Polly, Azure and Reinvent WP Cloud.

Does text to speech help SEO?

Audio can keep visitors on the page longer. The plugin also adds AudioObject schema markup to posts that have audio.

How do I upgrade to PRO?

  1. Choose a plan on our website.
  2. You’ll receive your license key by email from Freemius.
  3. In the plugin settings, enter your license key.

Can visitors jump to a sentence?

Yes. Visitors can double-click a sentence or word to play from there. You can turn this on in the plugin settings under Runtime.

Can I use it outside WordPress?

Yes. Use the JavaScript embed or the NPM package for React and Next.js.

Does it work in an Android WebView?

It works if your WebView supports the same browser APIs as a regular browser. We’ve tested it with a Trusted Web Activity (tutorial).
sections.changelog:
3.4.3

  • When you cancel your PRO subscription, the account button turns orange and shows “Not renewing” with the date PRO ends, instead of a renewal date. PRO keeps working until then.

3.4.2

  • Activating a PRO license key now turns on PRO right away. You no longer need to wait and refresh the settings page.
  • When a monthly or annual PRO license is activated, sites using Reinvent WP Cloud Free switch to Reinvent WP Cloud PRO automatically. There is nothing else to set up.

3.4.1

  • The block’s live preview no longer shows “Page not found” or an empty page when the post or page has no text yet, or was never saved. It shows the player with a note asking you to write something and save. Visitors and the WordPress Preview button are not affected.
  • Fixed newly generated audio failing to play on posts that don’t have a URL slug yet, such as drafts. The player showed “Audio generated successfully” as an error and could not sync the audio with the text.

3.4.0

  • Fixed the Reinvent WP TTS block showing only an empty box in the block editor. The block shows its shortcode editor and live preview again, styled correctly inside the block editor, including its settings dialog.
  • Fixed a console error in the block editor when another plugin or theme adds its own “admin-color-” classes to the page.

3.3.9

  • Fixed pronunciation and language detection with OpenAI: OpenAI shut down gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4 and gpt-4-turbo on October 23, 2026. The plugin now uses GPT-6 Luna, and GPT-6.1 Sol with medium reasoning for harder cases.
  • The site check only tests the OpenAI connection when pronunciation is turned on.

3.3.8

  • New Custom API audio source: connect any text to speech API like a Postman request (method, endpoint URL, headers and body, with {{text}} where the text goes), then choose where the audio is in the response. It starts as an OpenAI request, so you only paste your key. The URL, headers and body are saved encrypted.
  • New optional note next to each provider’s API key, so you remember which account the key belongs to.
  • Links from Reinvent WP Cloud Free and PRO to their details on reinventwp.com.
  • The Reinvent WP Apps page shows upcoming Reinvent WP apps as “Coming soon”.

3.3.7

  • New Reinvent WP Apps page: see your Reinvent WP apps, activate or install them, and open the full catalog on reinventwp.com.
  • New assistant: describe a problem with your site on the Apps page or the plugin page, attach a screenshot or log file, and get a link to the right setting.
  • Links to a setting now open Advanced mode and highlight that setting.

3.3.6

  • Update WP Live Preview

3.3.5

  • Update WP Live Preview

3.3.4

  • Added ElevenLabs Eleven v4 support, including v4 Turbo. Choose a model from the live ElevenLabs list or enter its model ID manually.
  • Audio previews in Simple and Advanced mode now show how Eleven v3 and v4 use audio tags such as [whispers] and [laughs] to guide delivery.

3.3.3

  • Fixed a highlighting bug with the Avada theme.

3.3.2

  • Improved the settings page design.

3.3.1

  • Improved the player design.

3.3.0

  • Added a feedback form.
